en: The postcard shows a picturesque, tree-covered hillside with a large building complex in the foreground, featuring red tile roofs and several architectural styles including domed rooftops. To the right is a formal garden and a broad promenade lined with trees and decorative plantings. The text on the postcard appears in the upper right corner and is written in German. The buildings suggest a historic spa or baths.
